theme.intro: Style defaults per widget type. Individual widgets can still override these.

builder.settingsNote: Top-level lvgl: options (fonts, theme, display background, style definitions).
builder.noWidgets: No widgets on this page yet.
builder.addWidgetToGroup: Add selected type into this tab/tile
builder.addChild: Add selected type as a child
builder.yamlNote: Edits the lvgl: block only. Applying re-parses it against the widget schemas -- keys outside a curated schema are kept verbatim, comments and formatting are not preserved.

inspector.selectWidget: Select a widget to edit it.
inspector.noTypeSettings: No type-specific settings for this widget.
inspector.layoutNote: Flex/grid container setup, per-cell placement and align_to.
inspector.partsNote: Style overrides for widget sub-parts (indicator, knob, …).

rawYaml.note: {type} isn't a builder-supported widget. Edit its raw YAML here -- it's written back verbatim on save. Child widgets stay editable in the tree.
